pr_title: fix: only provide npm package names to resolveSSRExternal
pr_body:
fix #2716

The root cause of #2716 seems to be that `resolveSSRExternal()` assumes its argument `knownImports` to be npm package names while `doBuild()` sets `knowImports` to `Object.keys(require('node_modules/.vite/_metadata.json').optimized)` which contains `vite-plugin-ssr/client/router`.

issue_context.title: [SSR] Failure upon building symlinked dependency nested path import
issue_context.body:
Vite chokes when: 1. trying to build `import { something } from 'some-dependency/nested/path'` and 2. `some-dependency` is symlinked.

The error stack: 

```shell
error during build:
Error: Cannot find module 'vite-plugin-ssr/client/router/package.json' from '/home/romuuu/.prog/files/code/vite-plugin-ssr/examples/react'
    at Function.resolveSync [as sync] (/home/romuuu/.prog/files/code/vite-plugin-ssr/examples/react/node_modules/resolve/lib/sync.js:102:15)
    at resolveFrom$2 (/home/romuuu/.prog/files/code/vite-plugin-ssr/examples/react/node_modules/vite/dist/node/chunks/dep-0776dd57.js:3883:29)
    at resolveSSRExternal (/home/romuuu/.prog/files/code/vite-plugin-ssr/examples/react/node_modules/vite/dist/node/chunks/dep-0776dd57.js:32175:51)
    at doBuild (/home/romuuu/.prog/files/code/vite-plugin-ssr/examples/react/node_modules/vite/dist/node/chunks/dep-0776dd57.js:44153:36)
    at processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:93:5)
    at async build (/home/romuuu/.prog/files/code/vite-plugin-ssr/examples/react/node_modules/vite/dist/node/chunks/dep-0776dd57.js:44101:16)
    at async CAC.<anonymous> (/home/romuuu/.prog/files/code/vite-plugin-ssr/examples/react/node_modules/vite/dist/node/cli.js:14072:9)
```

As the error stack shows, Vite erroneously believes `vite-plugin-ssr/client/router` to be an npm package.

I'm writing a patch and will open a PR.

I didn't respect the GitHub issue template because I don't think it to be relevant. Let me know if you want me to provide more infos such as a reproduction. But the PR should pretty clearly show what's going on.
